'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Jan Westergard LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough]]
* '''Username:''' Ghosttrain
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
